summary: Sanchay Payment Solutions will supply Meera Sweets with one card machine and settle card payments into its bank account. The minimum term is three years from installation, after which the agreement renews by itself for a year at a time unless Meera Sweets gives written notice at least sixty days before a renewal date. Ending it before the minimum term or a renewal period is over costs an exit fee of Rs. 42,000. Meera Sweets pays 1.8% of each card sale and a machine rental of Rs. 450 a month, both as amended from time to time by Sanchay. Meera Kulkarni, a partner, personally guarantees every amount Meera Sweets owes. Meera Sweets covers Sanchay against all claims, penalties and losses from card transactions at its shop. Indian law applies, and only the courts at Mumbai can hear disputes.
